source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Electrical-Body and Chassis, p.12-21

procedures.title: Cigarette lighter replacement
steps: Remove the vent control set screws and the screws holding the gear shift trim plate, and take off the plate.
Squeeze the lighter lamp clip and unplug the connector under the lighter housing.
Unscrew the retainer from the back of the housing and free the lighter from the trim plate.
